Subject: Follow-up: Deployment modes, EU residency, and APAC DR considerations

Hi Elena / NordBank security team —

Thanks for the clear requirements. Quick technical summary below — I’ll bring more detail to Thursday’s session but wanted to put these points in writing so you can circulate.

1) Hosted API (EU routing option)
- What it provides: Hosted endpoints with request handling inside our EU regions and tenant-scoped data deletion/retention controls.
- Residency guarantee: For production requests we can enforce EU-region routing (requests served in eu-west-1/eu-west-2, etc.) and retention policies scoped per account.
- Limitations: Shared infrastructure (multi-tenant) — suitable if your controls allow logical separation and Redwood-managed infrastructure.
- APAC DR: if you enable APAC as a DR endpoint on Hosted, requests to the APAC endpoint will be served from APAC regions; we do not automatically replicate EU production PII to APAC. If you require APAC DR for non-PII workloads only, we can configure routing rules and prefixes so only non-PII traffic hits APAC.

2) Dedicated (reserved capacity)
- What it provides: Dedicated GPU pools for your account running in a chosen region(s). Predictable throughput and softer isolation (single-tenant capacity) without full VPC networking.
- Residency guarantee: Can be provisioned in EU regions only for production workloads. Data plane stays inside the provisioned region by default.
- Timeline & commits: Typical provisioning 2–4 weeks (region dependent) + monthly commit (we’ll include sample numbers in the deck).
- APAC DR: We can provision a secondary Dedicated pool in APAC for non-PII workloads; cross-region replication is opt-in.

3) Private VPC / On‑prem
- What it provides: Customer-managed VPC with private control plane; supports strict network egress controls, private peering, and on-prem installs.
- Residency guarantee: Full control — your infra/config controls region/egress; recommended when legal/regulatory teams require VPC-level isolation.
- Timeline: Typically 6–10 weeks for first deployment (depending on contract, certificates, and networking setup).

Attachments I’m including: "redwood-eu-region-availability.pdf" (regions we support today) and a sample Dedicated provisioning checklist. Also attaching the SOC2 summary Lauren included for your security team.

Next steps from us:
- I’ll prepare a one-pager comparing isolation, timeline, and cost impact for Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private.
- We’ll confirm exact EU regions available for Dedicated (I’ve flagged eu-west-1 and eu-central-1 as commonly available) and send a concrete provisioning ETA after we have your preferred region(s).

Elena — if Thu Jun 17 10:00 CET still works we’ll send the calendar invite and the short technical agenda.

Thanks — looking forward to the call.

—Aditya
